cohort: 40 patients who underwent surgical repair of urinary fistula at the Urology, Multan Institute of Kidney Diseases Multan, and Urology Department BVH Hospital Bahawalpur from January 2017 to November 2018.
finding: Gynecologic surgery was the most common cause of urinary fistula (60%), and surgical repair was successful in 87.5% of cases.
mod_finding: VVF occurred in 12 patients (30%) following obstructed and prolonged labor and in 4 patients following cesarean sections.
